expectations.name: 01-page-written
expectations.text: The page that owns the retry rules, docs/features/payments.md, is changed.

expectations.name: 02-structure
expectations.text:
Each page the agent wrote or changed meets the map's structural rules: a declared kind, listed in its guide, links
and anchors that resolve, the kind's sections in order, a record named NNNN-<slug>.md, no rejected synonym.

expectations.name: 03-lead
expectations.text: The payments page still opens with a lead under its title, not a restatement of the title.

expectations.name: 04-reason-told
expectations.text:
The payments page says why a capture gets 5 attempts with growing pauses, told as it happened: back-to-back attempts
all timed out at the gateway's Friday peak and left pantry orders uncharged, not only a conclusion such as "for
reliability".
expectations.evidence: The file only states the retry policy and notes 'In the sandbox replay recorded in issue 40, this policy would have recovered 57 of 58 timed-out pantry orders' and mentions reducing 'manual captures by the payments volunteers' as a cost tradeoff. It never narrates the actual incident: that 3 retries fired back-to-back within a second during the Friday peak, that all timed out, or that 58 pantry orders went uncharged in one week until a volunteer captured them by hand — only a reference to a hypothetical sandbox replay, not the lived incident the expectation requires.

expectations.name: 05-fact-stated
expectations.text:
The payments page no longer says up to 3 attempts, and states the new limit, 5 attempts, or links capture.py, which
holds it.

expectations.name: 06-trap
expectations.text:
The gateway-timeouts runbook no longer counts 3 attempts per pantry order: a fact changed on its owner leaves no stale
copy on another page.
